papers.title: Birdwatcher's note
lines: Flamingos on the salt lake at Akrotiri each winter, a cloud of pink, a blur of leg.
I counted four hundred before the wind got up and I lost count.

papers.title: Beach warden's slip
lines: Loggerhead turtle nest marked, with a cage against the foxes and a sign against the rest of us.
If you see a hatchling, do not pick it up. Do not name it. Do not follow it to the sea.

papers.title: Archaeologist's note
lines: The Roman theatre at Kourion seats thousands. The view of the sea is better than the plays were.
Standing on the stage, I said a line. The stones did not applaud, but they listened.

papers.title: Station notice
lines: The Saturday tea dance resumes in the Hall. Biscuits provided. Medals optional.
This notice is a reminder that the band is the same band. They are very good. They are older.
